description:
Superbridger publishes one post to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and X, each in that platform's own format, right away or at a time you choose. With Superbridger in ChatGPT you can:

- See your brands and their connected social accounts.
- Plan and write posts, give each platform its own text, and check them before anything goes out: Superbridger shows exactly what each platform will get and anything it would refuse.
- Publish now or schedule up to 180 days ahead; move, cancel or retry posts, and take live posts down.
- Ask what's on the calendar, or how last week's posts did: views, likes, comments, reach, watch time and new followers from Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.
- Add videos and images from a public link, or attach them in the chat.

You need a Superbridger account with your social accounts connected. You sign in with it, pick the team, and choose whether ChatGPT may post or only read. ChatGPT asks before it publishes, moves, cancels or deletes anything. TikTok posts arrive as drafts in the TikTok app. Disconnect any time in Superbridger under Settings, Connected apps.

defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my brands and connected social accounts.
Write a post about our autumn menu for every platform and check it before anything goes out.
What's scheduled this week, and how did last week's posts do?
